name: Customer service
description: For support calls: how upset the customer is, what the agent does about it, and whether it is resolved or escalating.

detectors.name: Offers a fix
detectors.what: the speaker offers a fix, refund, replacement or other solution

detectors.name: Asks for a manager
detectors.what: the speaker asks to speak to a manager, supervisor or someone more senior
detectors.example: I want to speak to your supervisor.

detectors.name: Threatens to leave
detectors.what: the speaker says they will cancel, leave or take their business elsewhere
detectors.example: If this isn't fixed I'm cancelling.

detectors.name: Repeat problem
detectors.what: the speaker says the problem has happened before or that they have already contacted the company about it
detectors.example: This is the third time I've called about this.

detectors.name: Confusion
detectors.what: the speaker says they do not understand something
detectors.example: I don't understand what this charge is.

detectors.name: Asks to wait
detectors.what: the speaker asks the other person to hold or wait
detectors.example: Please bear with me while I check.

detectors.name: Empathy
detectors.what: the speaker acknowledges or shows understanding of another person's feelings
detectors.example: I can tell this has been really hard for you.

detectors.name: Question
detectors.what: the speaker asks a question or asks for information
detectors.example: Where did you buy the code?

detectors.name: Commitment
detectors.what: the speaker promises or commits to doing something
detectors.example: I will send it over by tomorrow.
